'''Marten Sirl''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Miner/Legends|miner]] living in the town of [[Vexen]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kallistas]]. His twelve-year [[Marten Sirl's daughter|daughter]] received a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] arm replacement thanks to [[Jondrell Inx]].
